messages:
emily: Starter report: onboarding sample broke for Pages users after the export-map tidy. Deploy error: "TypeError: RetryPolicy is not a function" and editor shows "Could not find declaration file for 'redwood-sdk'".

emily: Sample import: `import { RetryPolicy } from 'redwood-sdk'` — used to work.

raj: Can you paste the current package.json exports?

emily: snippet:
```json
"exports": {
  "./*": "./dist/*",
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
}
```
No `."` top-level mapping and no `types` field.

marco: Wildcard subpath is the culprit. It doesn't forward `.d.ts` and our rollup ESM bundle ended up as default-only (named exports stripped). CJS still had named exports, so local dev using ts-node/CJS didn't catch it.

raj: Quick repro: in an ESM project `import sdk from 'redwood-sdk'` then `sdk.RetryPolicy` is undefined. Editor uses auto-import -> points to `dist/index.mjs` and fails to find types.

ci-bot: created issue RED-5902 and draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-sdk/pull/1350 \u2014 proposed changes: add explicit top-level " . " export with `import`/`require`, add "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", and ensure rollup emits named exports.

emily: Workaround for affected users: `import Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'; const RetryPolicy = Redwood.RetryPolicy || Redwood.default?.RetryPolicy;` ugly but unblocks Pages.

marco: Long term: reintroduce a named-exports interop step in the ESM build (we used to run a small shim during bundle step). Also add CI that installs and imports package in a pure-ESM sandbox (Pages/Deno/Bun) and run `tsc --noEmit` against samples.

raj: Also add a lint rule to fail CI when samples still use `require()` or when package.json exports are wildcard-only without a `.` mapping.

docs-bot: Suggestion: update onboarding docs to call out ESM-only runtimes and provide an explicit compatibility checklist until we ship the fix.

emily: I'll update the onboarding template with a short note and the temporary import workaround. I'll also ping CS for the small set of customers who hit this.

raj: I'll land the PR once CI passes and follow up with a patch release and a release note.
